Market today: The mood is uncertain, driven by Trump's renewed threats to halt trade with key partners, which could severely impact global supply chains vital for your tech/chip names. Mixed signals on interest rates from recent jobs data add to the complexity.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -54.7% and a SELL. SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is already -32.25% and below its stop. SMH is also a TRIM, down -11.43% and nearing its stop. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further developments regarding Trump's trade rhetoric and how the market digests the conflicting signals on interest rates.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions, and stay alert to macro shifts.
plays: SOXL: Given the SELL status and -54.7% loss on this leveraged ETF, seriously consider trimming or exiting. Re-evaluate your stop.
SPAL: This new, leveraged position is already -32.25% and below its 21.38 stop. Respect the stop to limit further losses.
SMH: Watch SMH closely as it approaches its 540 stop. The scanner suggests TRIM.
